about:
Creative Wood Designs operates from Bismarck, North Dakota. The company has been crafting custom cabinetry for over 25 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly stated. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed.

The shop specializes in European-style custom cabinetry for residential clients. Its offerings span a range of cabinet styles, premium finishes, and hardware options tailored to individual design visions. Details about production processes, facility size, headcount, or annual volumes are not provided.

Creative Wood Designs serves homeowners throughout Central and Western North Dakota. Its customer base consists primarily of residential clients seeking custom cabinetry for kitchens, bathrooms, and other living spaces.

The company has not publicly stated a specific founding mission or differentiator beyond combining decades of experience with modern design.
